description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RequestTrait' used for handling HTTP request properties within the Nyholm Psr7 library. It provides methods for managing request target, method, and URI, including cloning and updating headers.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target string, defaulting to '/' or constructing it from the URI's path and query.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current object with the specified request target after validating it.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method (e.g., GET, POST) of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current object with the specified HTTP method set.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a clone with the specified URI, optionally preserving the host header.

methods.name: updateHostFromUri
methods.description: Updates the 'Host' header based on the URI's host and port, ensuring it conforms to HTTP standards.
